q: The factory installed a new _____ that can assemble parts twice as fast.
translation: 工厂安装了一台新机器，组装零件的速度能提高一倍。

q: The dog went _____ and started chasing its own tail in circles.
translation: 那只狗变得疯狂，开始转着圈追自己的尾巴。

q: The waiter politely asked, 'Would you like dessert, _____?'
translation: 服务员礼貌地问道：'女士，您想要甜点吗？'

q: She subscribes to a monthly fashion _____ that covers the latest trends.
translation: 她订阅了一本每月出版的时尚杂志，报道最新潮流。

q: The children were convinced that the old tree had some kind of _____ power.
explain: magic n/adj. 魔法 / 有魔力的
translation: 孩子们坚信那棵老树有某种魔法力量。

q: I _____ the package yesterday, so it should arrive by Thursday.
translation: 我昨天把包裹寄出去了，所以应该周四就能到。

q: The _____ reason for his success is his willingness to work harder than anyone else.
translation: 他成功的主要原因是他比任何人都更愿意努力。

q: The engineer regularly _____ the equipment to ensure it runs smoothly.
translation: 工程师定期维护设备，以确保其平稳运行。

q: She _____ in computer science and hopes to work in artificial intelligence.
translation: 她主修计算机科学，希望能在人工智能领域工作。

q: The _____ of the committee voted in favor of the new proposal.
translation: 委员会的大多数成员投票支持这项新提案。

q: She _____ a delicious chocolate cake for her daughter's birthday party.
translation: 她为女儿的生日派对做了一个美味的巧克力蛋糕。

q: The zoo just welcomed a baby _____ elephant, weighing over two hundred pounds.
explain: male adj/n. 男性 / 男性的
translation: 动物园刚迎来一头雄性小象，体重超过两百磅。

q: The young _____ saved the child from the burning building without hesitation.
translation: 那位年轻男子毫不犹豫地救出了那名被困在着火大楼里的孩子。

q: Despite the heavy traffic, we _____ to arrive at the airport just in time.
translation: 尽管交通很拥堵，我们还是设法及时赶到了机场。

q: The store _____ offered a full refund when the customer complained about the defective product.
translation: 当顾客投诉产品有缺陷时，商店经理提供了全额退款。

q: The discovery of fire was one of the most important milestones in the history of _____.
translation: 火的发现是人类历史上最重要的里程碑之一。

q: His polite _____ made a strong impression on everyone at the formal dinner.
translation: 他彬彬有礼的举止在正式晚宴上给所有人留下了深刻印象。

q: There are so _____ interesting books in this library that I never know which one to pick.
translation: 这家图书馆里有太多有趣的书，我总是不知道该选哪一本。

q: Tourists should carry a detailed _____ when hiking through unfamiliar mountain trails.
translation: 游客在不熟悉的山路上徒步时应该携带一张详细的地图。

q: Running a full _____ requires months of training and strong mental endurance.
translation: 跑一场完整的马拉松需要数月的训练和坚强的心理耐力。

q: The teacher always _____ important dates on the calendar with a red pen.
translation: 老师总是用红笔在日历上标记重要的日期。

q: The local farmers' _____ opens every Saturday morning with fresh organic produce.
translation: 当地的农产品市场每周六早晨开放，售卖新鲜的有机产品。

q: After twenty years of _____, they still celebrated their anniversary with a romantic dinner.
translation: 结婚二十年后，他们仍然以一顿浪漫的晚餐来庆祝婚姻纪念日。

q: He _____ his college sweetheart in a beautiful outdoor ceremony last summer.
translation: 他去年夏天在一场美丽的户外仪式上娶了他的大学恋人。

q: A _____ of people gathered in the square to watch the fireworks display.
translation: 大量人群聚集在广场观看烟花表演。

q: The construction project required a _____ amount of concrete and steel.
explain: massive adj. 巨大的，大量的
translation: 这个建设项目需要大量的混凝土和钢材。

q: It takes years of practice to truly _____ the art of playing the violin.
translation: 真正掌握拉小提琴的艺术需要多年的练习。

q: The color of her scarf perfectly _____ the shade of her shoes.
translation: 她围巾的颜色与鞋子的色调完美匹配。

q: The designer chose a soft cotton _____ for the summer dress collection.
translation: 设计师为夏季连衣裙系列选择了一种柔软的棉材料。

q: Students who excel in _____ often have strong logical reasoning abilities.
translation: 在数学方面出色的学生通常具有很强的逻辑推理能力。

q: It _____ a great deal to her that her parents attended her graduation ceremony.
translation: 父母出席她的毕业典礼对她来说非常重要。

q: The wine needs to age for several years before it reaches its fully _____ flavor.
translation: 这款葡萄酒需要陈酿数年才能达到完全成熟的风味。

q: The elevator has a _____ capacity of fifteen people for safety reasons.
explain: maximum n/adj. 最大值 / 最大的
translation: 出于安全考虑，电梯的最大载客量为十五人。

q: _____ we should leave earlier to avoid the rush hour traffic on the highway.
translation: 也许我们应该早点出发，以避开高速公路的拥堵时段。

q: A balanced _____ should include vegetables, protein, and some carbohydrates.
translation: 一顿均衡的餐食应该包含蔬菜、蛋白质和一些碳水化合物。

q: This symbol _____ 'danger' in almost every country around the world.
translation: 这个符号在几乎全世界每个国家都意味着危险。

q: The _____ of this ancient poem has been debated by scholars for centuries.
translation: 这首古诗的含义已经被学者们争论了几个世纪。

q: The organization helps people find legal _____ to resolve their disputes peacefully.
translation: 该组织帮助人们寻找合法的手段来和平解决他们的纠纷。

q: The architect carefully _____ every wall before ordering the construction materials.
translation: 建筑师在订购建筑材料之前仔细测量了每一面墙。

q: The recipe calls for lean _____ instead of fatty pork for a healthier option.
translation: 这道菜谱要求使用瘦肉而不是肥猪肉，以作为更健康的选择。

q: The skilled _____ diagnosed the engine problem in less than thirty minutes.
translation: 那位熟练的机械师在不到三十分钟内就诊断出了发动机问题。

q: The athlete proudly wore the gold _____ around her neck during the victory ceremony.
translation: 在颁奖典礼上，这位运动员骄傲地将金奖牌挂在脖子上。

q: All new employees must pass a _____ examination before they can start working.
translation: 所有新员工在开始工作之前都必须通过医学体检。

q: Advances in modern _____ have significantly increased the average human lifespan.
translation: 现代医学的进步显著提高了人类的平均寿命。

q: The artist chose oil paint as his preferred _____ for the landscape portrait.
translation: 艺术家选择油画颜料作为风景肖像的首选媒介。

q: We first _____ at a conference in Chicago about three years ago.
translation: 我们大约三年前在芝加哥的一次会议上第一次见面。

q: The weekly team _____ usually lasts about forty-five minutes and covers project updates.
translation: 每周的团队会议通常持续约四十五分钟，讨论项目进展。

q: Every active _____ of the club has the right to vote on important decisions.
translation: 俱乐部的每一位活跃成员都有权对重要决定进行投票。

q: The gym offers a discounted annual _____ for students and senior citizens.
translation: 健身房为学生和老年人提供折扣年度会员资格。

q: The city built a beautiful _____ to honor the soldiers who died in the war.
translation: 这座城市建造了一座美丽的纪念碑，以纪念战争中牺牲的士兵。

q: The old photograph brought back a vivid _____ of my childhood summers at the beach.
translation: 这张老照片唤起了我对童年在海滩度过夏天的生动记忆。

q: Regular exercise has been proven to improve both physical and _____ health.
explain: mental adj. 精神的，心理的
translation: 定期锻炼已被证明能改善身体和心理健康。

q: She never _____ her previous work experience during the interview.
translation: 她在面试中从未提及她之前的工作经验。

q: The restaurant's seasonal _____ features dishes made with locally sourced ingredients.
translation: 这家餐厅的时令菜单以当地采购的食材制作的菜肴为特色。

q: The king showed _____ to the prisoners and allowed them to return home safely.
translation: 国王对囚犯表现出仁慈，允许他们安全返回家乡。

q: He was _____ trying to help when he accidentally broke the antique vase.
translation: 他只是想帮忙，却不小心打碎了那个古董花瓶。

q: Everyone sang _____ Christmas carols as they gathered around the decorated tree.
translation: 大家围坐在装饰好的圣诞树旁，唱着快乐的圣诞颂歌。

q: The kitchen was a complete _____ after the children tried to bake cookies by themselves.
translation: 孩子们尝试自己做饼干后，厨房变得一片混乱。

q: Please leave a detailed _____ if I do not answer the phone right away.
translation: 如果我没有立即接听电话，请留下详细的信息。

q: The bridge was reinforced with strong steel _____ to withstand heavy loads.
translation: 这座桥用坚固的钢金属加固，以承受重载。

q: The scientist developed a new _____ for detecting early signs of the disease.
translation: 这位科学家开发了一种新方法来检测疾病的早期迹象。

q: The swimming pool is exactly fifty _____ long, which is standard for Olympic competitions.
translation: 游泳池正好五十米长，这是奥林匹克比赛的标准长度。

q: Students used a powerful _____ to examine the tiny organisms in the water sample.
translation: 学生们使用高倍显微镜来观察水样中的微小生物。

q: The teacher asked the student sitting in the _____ of the room to answer the question.
translation: 老师让坐在房间中间的学生回答这个问题。

q: The New Year's celebration began exactly at _____ with fireworks and loud cheers.
translation: 新年庆祝活动在午夜准时开始，伴随着烟花和欢呼声。

q: The ancient castle was built to demonstrate the king's military _____ to neighboring nations.
translation: 这座古堡的建造是为了向邻国展示国王的军事力量。

q: The doctor said it was only a _____ infection and should clear up within a few days.
explain: mild adj. 温和的，轻微的
translation: 医生说这只是轻微感染，几天内就会痊愈。

q: The nearest gas station is about five _____ down the road, so we should stop soon.
translation: 最近的加油站大约在沿路五英里处，所以我们应该尽快停下来。

q: The country's _____ forces were deployed to assist with the disaster relief efforts.
translation: 该国的军事力量被部署来协助救灾工作。

q: The farmer woke up early every morning to _____ the cows before sunrise.
translation: 农民每天黎明前起床给奶牛挤奶。

q: The difference between the two measurements was only a few _____, so they were essentially the same.
translation: 两次测量之间的差异只有几毫米，所以它们本质上是相同的。

q: The lottery jackpot reached over fifty _____ dollars, attracting millions of ticket buyers.
translation: 彩票头奖达到了五千多百万美元，吸引了数百万购票者。

q: She never _____ the long commute because she enjoys listening to audiobooks in the car.
translation: 她从不介意漫长的通勤，因为她喜欢在车里听有声书。

q: The coal _____ was closed down last year due to safety concerns and low demand.
translation: 由于安全问题和需求低迷，这座煤矿于去年关闭。

q: Water from natural springs often contains important _____ that are beneficial for health.
translation: 天然泉水通常含有对健康有益的重要矿物质。

q: The restaurant requires a _____ order of twenty dollars for home delivery service.
explain: minimum n/adj. 最小值 / 最小的
translation: 这家餐厅要求外卖订单的最低金额为二十美元。

q: The foreign _____ traveled to Geneva to participate in the peace negotiations.
explain: minister n. 部长，大臣，牧师
translation: 外交部长前往日内瓦参加和平谈判。

q: The accident caused only _____ damage to the car, so it was easily repaired.
translation: 事故只给汽车造成了轻微损坏，所以很容易修复。

q: Only a small _____ of the shareholders voted against the proposed merger.
explain: minority n. 少数，少数民族
translation: 只有少数股东投票反对拟议的合并。

q: Wait just a _____ while I grab my keys from the kitchen counter.
translation: 请等一分钟，我去厨房台面上拿钥匙。

q: She looked at her reflection in the bathroom _____ before leaving for the interview.
translation: 她在去面试前看了看浴室镜子里的自己。

q: The bus always _____ the old stop because the route was changed last month.
translation: 这辆公交车总是错过老车站，因为路线已于上个月更改。

q: The defense system is designed to intercept incoming _____ before they reach their targets.
translation: 该防御系统旨在拦截来袭的导弹，使其无法到达目标。

q: The police are searching for a _____ teenager who disappeared three days ago.
explain: missing adj. 失踪的，缺少的
translation: 警方正在寻找一名三天前失踪的失踪青少年。

q: The astronaut described his _____ to the space station as the greatest adventure of his life.
translation: 宇航员将前往空间站的任务描述为他生命中最伟大的冒险。

q: A thick _____ rolled in from the ocean and covered the coastal town by dawn.
translation: 浓雾从海面飘来，到黎明时已经笼罩了沿海小镇。

q: It was a costly _____ to invest in the company without doing proper research first.
translation: 在没有进行适当调查的情况下投资这家公司是一个代价高昂的错误。

q: The chef carefully _____ the ingredients before putting the dish in the oven.
translation: 厨师小心地将原料混合在一起，然后把菜放入烤箱。

q: The cake batter should have a smooth _____ without any lumps of flour.
translation: 蛋糕面糊应该是光滑的混合物，没有任何面粉结块。

q: Please switch the phone to silent _____ before entering the concert hall.
translation: 进入音乐厅前，请将手机切换到静音模式。

q: She _____ for a well-known fashion brand during Paris Fashion Week.
translation: 她在巴黎时装周期间为一家知名时尚品牌做模特。

q: The museum combines _____ architecture with traditional design elements from the region.
translation: 这座博物馆将现代建筑与该地区的传统设计元素相结合。

q: At that exact _____, the lights went out and the entire room fell into darkness.
translation: 就在那一刻，灯熄灭了，整个房间陷入黑暗。

q: He saved enough _____ over five years to finally buy his own apartment.
translation: 他五年里攒够了钱，终于买下了自己的公寓。

q: The nurse _____ the patient's heart rate continuously throughout the night.
translation: 护士整夜持续监控病人的心率。

q: A clever _____ managed to open the cage door and escape into the nearby forest.
translation: 一只聪明的猴子设法打开了笼门，逃进了附近的森林。

q: The project must be completed within one _____ to meet the client's deadline.
translation: 该项目必须在一个月内完成，以满足客户的截止日期。

q: The magazine publishes a _____ issue covering current events and cultural topics.
translation: 该杂志出版月刊，涵盖时事和文化话题。

q: The cheerful music in the café instantly improved my _____ after a stressful day.
translation: 在紧张的一天后，咖啡馆里欢快的音乐立刻改善了我的心情。

q: The full _____ rose above the horizon and illuminated the quiet lake below.
translation: 满月从地平线升起，照亮了下方宁静的湖面。

q: The story has a clear _____ about the importance of honesty and kindness.
translation: 这个故事有一个明确的道德寓意，关于诚实和善良的重要性。

q: The plan is too expensive; _____, it would take twice as long as the alternative.
translation: 这个计划太昂贵了；而且，它需要的时间是替代方案的两倍。

q: I prefer to go jogging early in the _____ before the streets become crowded.
translation: 我喜欢在早晨早些时候去慢跑，在街道变得拥挤之前。

q: A single _____ bite can transmit dangerous diseases in tropical regions.
translation: 在热带地区，一只蚊子叮咬就可能传播危险的疾病。

q: The crowd consisted _____ of young students who were eager to hear the speaker.
translation: 人群主要由热切想听演讲的年轻学生组成。

q: The cat _____ her kittens with great care, keeping them warm and fed.
explain: mother v. 像母亲般照顾
translation: 那只猫像母亲一样精心照顾她的小猫，让它们保持温暖和吃饱。

q: The dancer's graceful _____ across the stage captivated the entire audience.
translation: 舞者在舞台上优雅的动作迷住了所有观众。

q: Good teachers know how to _____ students who have lost interest in learning.
translation: 好老师知道如何激励那些对学习失去兴趣的学生。

q: The detective spent weeks trying to understand the _____ behind the unexpected crime.
translation: 侦探花了数周时间试图理解这起意外犯罪背后的动机。

q: The electric _____ in the new car is much quieter than traditional gasoline engines.
translation: 新车中的电动马达比传统的汽油发动机安静得多。

q: The museum _____ a new exhibition of ancient artifacts every spring.
translation: 博物馆每年春天都会举办一场新的古代文物展览。

q: Climbing the highest _____ in the range requires specialized equipment and training.
translation: 攀登该山脉中最高的山需要专门的装备和训练。

q: The computer _____ stopped working, so I had to replace it with a new one.
translation: 电脑鼠标坏了，所以我不得不换一个新的。

q: The dentist examined the patient's _____ and found two small cavities.
translation: 牙医检查了病人的口腔，发现了两处小蛀牙。

q: The family is _____ to a larger apartment because they need more space.
translation: 这家人正在搬到一个更大的公寓，因为他们需要更多空间。

q: The civil rights _____ changed American society in profound and lasting ways.
translation: 民权运动以深远而持久的方式改变了美国社会。

q: The new _____ based on the bestselling novel will be released next Friday.
translation: 这部根据畅销小说改编的新电影将于下周五上映。

q: After the heavy rain, the trail was covered in thick _____ that made hiking difficult.
translation: 大雨过后，小径上覆盖着厚厚的泥，使徒步变得困难。

q: The disease can cause _____ symptoms that affect different parts of the body.
translation: 这种疾病会引起多种症状，影响身体的不同部位。

q: The detective discovered that the victim had been _____ at least twelve hours before.
translation: 侦探发现受害者至少在十二小时前就被谋杀了。

q: Stretching before exercise helps prevent injuries and reduces soreness in the _____.
translation: 运动前拉伸有助于防止受伤，并减少肌肉酸痛。

q: The national _____ houses thousands of rare paintings and historical documents.
translation: 国家博物馆收藏了数千幅稀有画作和历史文献。

q: Wild _____ started to appear everywhere in the forest after the week of constant rain.
translation: 经过一周的连续降雨，野生蘑菇开始在森林中到处出现。

q: The soothing _____ from the piano helped the baby fall asleep quickly.
translation: 钢琴传来的舒缓音乐帮助宝宝很快入睡。

q: The talented young _____ performed a solo concert that received a standing ovation.
translation: 这位才华横溢的年轻音乐家举办了一场独奏音乐会，获得了起立鼓掌。
